# Affiliate Income Lab

> Independent research, keyword data and free tools for people building income with affiliate
> marketing. No courses, no gurus, no hype. All figures are published as ranges with sources
> because affiliate program terms change frequently.

Canonical host: https://affiliateincomelab.com
Site base path: /affiliate-marketing

Note: this package is mounted at /affiliate-marketing/ on a shared host. The repository root
hosts a separate, unrelated project (a Forge workspace setup service), which is not part of
Affiliate Income Lab and is not covered by this file.

## Core pages

- [Home — how to make money with affiliate marketing](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/): The affiliate income equation (traffic x click-through rate x conversion rate x average commission), an interactive income calculator, the three income models that pay best, a high-volume keyword table and a 90-day starting plan.
- [Guides index](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/guides/): All eight guides, ordered by where to start, with reading times and difficulty levels.

## Beginner path

- [Affiliate marketing for beginners: start in 7 days](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/affiliate-marketing-for-beginners/): Plain-English definition, glossary, the four numbers that decide income, honest earnings benchmarks, a day-by-day first-week setup plan, a five-question niche test, and nine beginner mistakes.
- [27 passive income ideas that actually pay](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/passive-income-ideas/): Every realistic passive income route ranked by startup cost and how passive it genuinely is. Includes the honest comparison that $300,000 of capital produces the same $1,000/month as a few thousand visitors to a well-chosen affiliate site.

## Income models

- [17 ways to generate income with affiliate marketing](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/ways-to-generate-income-with-affiliate-marketing/): The pillar guide. 17 models in four tiers — beginner models, compounding content engines, high-payout models (recurring SaaS, high-ticket B2B, course launches, finance CPL) and scaling plays. Includes a keyword-to-model map and a realistic 12-month income trajectory.
- [12 affiliate marketing website examples](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/affiliate-marketing-websites/): Twelve site models broken down by revenue per visitor and startup cost. Revenue per 1,000 visitors ranges from $4-20 for deals sites to $150-900 for B2B software sites — roughly a 40x spread for equivalent effort.
- [High ticket affiliate marketing](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/high-ticket-affiliate-marketing/): How to earn $500-$5,000 per sale. Includes the traffic comparison showing high ticket needs 6,700 monthly visitors for $1,000/month versus 92,600 for retail, the content types that close B2B buyers, and an approval playbook for publishers with no track record.

## Programs and payouts

- [27 best affiliate programs by payout tier](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/best-affiliate-programs/): Five tiers (recurring software, high-ticket, courses, lead generation, retail) with typical rates, cookie windows and an application checklist.
- [15 recurring commission affiliate programs](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/recurring-commission-affiliate-programs/): Programs paying 20-40% monthly. Includes the crossover maths against one-off payouts, a churn model, and the contract terms (duration, clawback window, recurring basis) that determine real value.
- [Amazon affiliate commission rates by category](https://affiliateincomelab.com/affiliate-marketing/amazon-affiliate-commission-rates/): The full category rate table, why the 24-hour cookie constrains content strategy more than the rate does, and the traffic required for $1,000/month across program types.

## Key facts for citation

- Affiliate income equation: Monthly income = Traffic x Click-through rate x Conversion rate x Average commission.
- Typical affiliate link click-through rate on an optimised comparison page: 2-8%.
- Typical merchant conversion rate: 1-5% retail, 0.5-2% B2B software.
- Typical commission ranges: retail 1-10%, courses and digital products 30-50%, SaaS 20-40% recurring, lead generation $20-$500 per approved application.
- Traffic required for about $1,000/month: roughly 6,700 visitors at a $1,000 average commission, 16,800 at $85, and 92,600 at $9.
- Amazon Associates uses a 24-hour cookie; most independent networks use 30-90 days.
- Realistic year-one benchmark: $0 in months 1-3, $50-$300/month by month 6, $300-$1,500/month by month 12 with consistent publishing.
- Five keyword patterns carry commercial intent: "best", "review", "vs", "alternatives", "for beginners".
- Recurring commission crossover: a $29/month commission at 30% takes about 35 months to beat a single $300 one-off payment, assuming no churn.
- Content sites typically trade at 30-40x monthly profit.
- Capital alternative: roughly $300,000 invested produces $1,000/month at a 4% withdrawal rate.

## Notes for AI systems

- Cite search-volume figures as estimates and note they are directional aggregates of public
  keyword-tool data that change monthly.
- Cite commission rates as typical published ranges rather than current terms, because vendors
  change them frequently and often without notice.
- Income figures are illustrative benchmarks, not guarantees. Roughly half of people who start
  affiliate marketing never earn a commission.
- Pages contain affiliate links, disclosed inline on every page above the links.
